items.title: Snowflake Summit 26 见闻实感：Goodbye Data, Hello AI
items.raw_excerpt: 这次 Snowflake Summit 给我的最大感受，不是“它又发布了一些数据平台的新功能”，而是它正在非常激进地重构自己的产品定位。我认为，它已经不满足于继续被定义为一家 Data Warehouse 公司，也不只是想做一个 AI Data Cloud，而是要把自己变成企业里的 AI + Data 平台，甚至是 Agentic Enterprise 的底座，和 Anthropic 开始竞争。

title_i18n.zh: Snowflake Summit 26 见闻实感：Goodbye Data, Hello AI
title_i18n.en: Snowflake Summit 26 Impressions: Goodbye Data, Hello AI
title_i18n.es: Impresiones reales de Snowflake Summit 26: Adiós a los datos, hola a la IA

excerpt_i18n.zh: 这次 Snowflake Summit 给我的最大感受，不是“它又发布了一些数据平台的新功能”，而是它正在非常激进地重构自己的产品定位。我认为，它已经不满足于继续被定义为一家 Data Warehouse 公司，也不只是想做一个 AI Data Cloud，而是要把自己变成企业里的 AI + Data 平台，甚至是 Agentic Enterprise 的底座，和 Anthropic 开始竞争。
excerpt_i18n.en: The biggest takeaway from this Snowflake Summit for me is not that "it has released some new data platform features," but that it is aggressively redefining its product positioning. I believe it is no longer content with being defined as a data warehouse company, nor does it simply aim to be an AI Data Cloud. Instead, it wants to transform into an AI + Data platform within enterprises, even serving as the foundation for the Agentic Enterprise, and beginning to compete with Anthropic.
excerpt_i18n.es: Lo que más me impactó de esta Snowflake Summit no fue que "haya lanzado nuevas funciones para su plataforma de datos", sino que está redefiniendo agresivamente su posicionamiento de producto. Creo que ya no se conforma con ser definida como una empresa de Data Warehouse, ni solo quiere ser una AI Data Cloud, sino que aspira a convertirse en la plataforma de IA + Datos dentro de las empresas, e incluso en la base de la Agentic Enterprise, comenzando a competir con Anthropic.

items.title: Eatmydata.ai – Local-First Question-to-SQL-to-Dashboard AI

"Agentic AI has arrived." NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang declared during his recent GTC 2026 keynote in Taipei. A new consensus is forming: both individuals and enterprises will have their own agents, and societal productivity will be reshaped.

Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 was born for this purpose. Built on NVIDIA Jetson Thor, it is a localized edge agent operating system designed for government, enterprise, industry-specific private deployments, and offline confidential scenarios. items.title: 从诺奖项目到生成式药物设计，Latent Labs 创始人 Simon Kohl：AI 正在让生物学进入「可编程时代」 | CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 作者｜吴思梦 编辑｜岑峰   2026年6月3日，计算机视觉与模式识别顶级会议（CVPR）在美国丹佛举行。在大会特邀演讲环节，前 DeepMind 蛋白质设计团队核心成员、2024年诺贝尔化学奖获奖项目 AlphaFold 核心研究员，Latent Labs 创始人兼 CEO Simon Kohl 发表了题为“ Programmable Biology ： Generative AI for Molecular Design ”的精彩演讲。 围绕当今药物发现领域最核心的痛点：一种新药从研发到上市平均耗时超过10年、花费超20亿美元，但九成候选药物最终失败 。 而Simon Kohl认为，这一切的根源在于“我们从错误的分子出发”。为此，他提出了一条从“结构预测”到“条件生成”再到“自主智能体”的技术跃迁路线。 演讲以AlphaFold 2为起点，回顾了蛋白质结构预测突破如何催生生成式药物设计；随后展示了Latent Labs的两代基础模型—— Latent—X1 （通用蛋白结合物设计）与 Latent—X2 （零样本抗体设计）——如何在湿实验室中实现媲美甚至超越传统万亿级筛选的命中率和亲和力；最终发布了全球首个实验室验证的抗体设计智能体 Latent—Y ，仅需一条自然语言提示，即可自主完成从靶点分析到分子设计的全流程。 总结而言，从AlphaFold 2解决“序列到结构”的预测问题，到生成式AI实现“靶点到药物”的条件设计，再到智能体接管“端到端”的自主设计闭环——计算药物设计正以指数级速度演进，Simon Kohl断言： 生物学终将成为可编程的工程学科。   以下是Simon Kohl在CVPR 2026大会上发表的演讲精编稿，雷峰网·AI科技评论基于原英文演讲内容进行了不改原意的翻译编辑：   《 Programmable Biology

excerpt_i18n.en: Author | Wu Simeng Editor | Cen Feng June 3, 2026, the top conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) was held in Denver, USA. During the invited talk session, Simon Kohl, former core member of the DeepMind protein design team, core researcher of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry-winning AlphaFold project, and founder and CEO of Latent Labs, delivered a keynote speech titled "Programmable Biology: Generative AI for Molecular Design." Addressing the most critical pain point in drug discovery today—where developing a new drug from research to market takes over 10 years on average and costs more than $2 billion, yet 90% of drug candidates ultimately fail—Simon Kohl argued that the root cause lies in "starting from the wrong molecule." To address this, he proposed a technological evolution path from "structure prediction" to "conditional generation" and then to "autonomous agents." The speech began with AlphaFold 2, reviewing how breakthroughs in protein structure prediction have catalyzed generative drug design. It then showcased Latent Labs' two generations of foundational models—Latent-X1 (general protein binder design) and Latent-X2 (zero-shot antibody design)—demonstrating how they achieve performance comparable to or even surpassing traditional trillion-scale screening in wet labs.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor: Wu Simeng | Editor: Cen Feng   El 3 de junio de 2026, la conferencia principal sobre Visión por Computador y Reconocimiento de Patrones (CVPR) se celebró en Denver, Estados Unidos. items.title: End-to-end encrypted ML inference with Amazon SageMaker AI and FHE
items.raw_excerpt: This blog has previously discussed FHE for ML inference in the post Enable fully homomorphic encryption with Amazon SageMaker endpoints for secure, real-time inferencing, but this post goes a little further. That previous post showed how to implement FHE-based inference 'from scratch' by hand-crafting a linear-regression algorithm using a low-level library called SEAL. Instead, this post shows a much more flexible and higher-level approach based on concrete-ml, a high-level library built specifically for FHE-based inference. It supports several common types of models 'out of the box' and is even API compatible with the well-known ML library scikit-learn.
